data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: Can I pay promoters on what they sell?
Each promoter gets their own link, and Catch shows the visits, bookings and revenue from it. How you pay them is up to you.
How do the groups work at a mixer?
Catch puts guests into small groups from what they told you when they booked, and changes them a few times through the night. You set how many rounds and how long.
Who runs each group on a crawl?
A group lead from your team, on their own phone. They see their group, confirm who left and who arrived, and get late arrivals sent their way.
Their lead marks them as gone home. At the end, anyone not accounted for shows up on your screen.
No. They book, check in and see their group in their phone’s browser.
Can the venues see the plan?
Share the route and timings with your team and venues before the night.
